meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
India mein oily aur acne-prone skin ke liye ₹500 ke andar kai behtareen options available hain jo excess oil ko control karte hain aur pores ko saaf rakhte hain:

The CeraVe Foaming Cleanser features **ceramides and niacinamide** to cleanse excess oil while protecting your skin barrier.

The Foxtale Oil & Acne Control Face Wash uses **2% salicylic acid** to deeply clear pores and prevent breakouts without stripping moisture.

The Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash combines **green tea and glycolic acid** to control sebum and gently exfoliate the skin.

The The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Face Wash blends **salicylic acid and niacinamide** to reduce blemishes and balance oil production.

The Himalaya Neem Purifying Face Wash relies on **neem and turmeric** to purify oily skin and fight acne naturally on a budget.

The Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash offers **antioxidant green tea** to refresh oily skin and clear stubborn impurities.

The mCaffeine Coffee Face Wash utilizes **pure Arabica coffee** to deep-clean impurities while keeping the skin soft.

The Plum Rice Water Face Wash uses **2% niacinamide** to brighten tone and regulate daily oil production.

The Biotique Pineapple Face Wash provides a **soap-free pineapple and neem** formula to eliminate excess grease affordably.

The Himalaya Lemon Face Wash features **lemon and honey** to refresh skin and remove excess oil without over-drying.
